purpose: Full-scope Huasteca source investigation and bounded repairs; no native certification
nhe_report:
Scope fully examined: 335 missing canonical full values, plus independently all 384 inherited values. Of missing values, 328 are exact full-value matches to the already read Navajo canonical packet, including all long guides; seven remaining differences were read directly. No P0/P1 cutoff. Current packet: 16 bounded candidate values pending independent review; 302 deferred; 15 identifiers/numerics not authored; two separate reuse aliases. No repository changes. No native-language or installed-layout certification, and no claim all existing translations are good.

Primary: Tlahtolxitlauhcayotl. Chicontepec, Veracruz, John Sullivan and eight named coauthors, IDIEZ/University of Warsaw. Confirmed full source https://www.nahuatlhuasteca.com/NahuatlSullivanDictionaryTlahtolxitlauhcayotl_Chicontepec_Veracru.pdf locally at /tmp/huasteca-sources/chicontepec.pdf and .txt. Intro directly read: ordinary prose omits vowel-length macrons used in headwords. Intro also distinguishes c/qui/qu object prefixes from quin for animate plural objects, so inanimate images are not mechanically given animate quin merely because English says images. This supports bounded constructions, not all application-specific senses or inflected technical prose. No other Nahuatl language converted into nhe.

Candidate provenance (PDF pages, not printed page numbering):
- add images / add images first: TLALIA p510, IXCOPINCAYOTL p264; actual imperative XICTLALI appears in dictionary usage. Digital image meaning is consonant with image/camera definition and existing catalogue.
- two assembly limit sentences: same image basis plus TECPANA/arrangement p434, QUIXTIA p426, AHCI insufficiency p26. Explicit <=20 paraphrase keeps bound; longer sentence requires removing one input to add another, not deleting source file.
- apply to all / apply to these images: CHIHUA p105 with action sense, XI imperative p601; object agreement follows intro. Context is current selected operation applied to inputs, not inventing a new action.
- Edit in Paint: PATLA p382 change/replace; proper mode identifier retained.
- same generic/height/width: CENCAH p88 expressly has sameness senses. Width PATLAUHCA p384; height uses existing nhe dimension label rather than unverified new term. Generic placeholder unchanged.
- widths / width-in: PATLAUHCA p384 and existing dimension pattern; %1$s preserved. No numeric-only padding.
- Search: TEMOA p441 plus source introduction xitechtemo usage and XI p601. Plain command, not claim to an attested software-specific label.
- Strikethrough: TLAHUAZANTLI p502 line, TLALIA p510, source attested spatial itlahcotiyan tocamac (middle of mouth) construction, not bare TLAHCO (half), and existing underline construction; specifies text middle. A compositional description, not a standardized typography term or independent native verification of whole phrase.
- preview-memory error: AHCI p26 source example with insufficient money supports insufficiency sense, not only arriving. RAM retained; existing preview wording extended with filename placeholder. Indexed format preserved.
- selected image no longer in assembly: existing chosen form, IXCOPINCAYOTL p264, arrangement source p434 and TLAPEHPENIA p530. Ayoc expresses no longer; does not delete/overwrite input.

Withdrawals after deeper/independent scrutiny:
- bare placed/not placed TLALTOC candidates removed. Completing entry across pp510–511 shows transitive/specialized usage, not evidence for bare passive status.
- five page candidates removed after parent review. AMATL p37 is paper/writing material and current File label; explicit document-page sense not sufficiently established. No conflation of pages with files.
- technical/legal/long prose cannot be composed merely by stringing dictionary headwords. Those candidates remain deferred with complete canonical text retained in scope packet. No English copying to claim translation completion.

Inherited review: two narrow full repairs in /tmp/nhe384-existing-proposed-fixes.json: selected destination explicitly uses campa tictlapehpenqui rather than here; Draw again specifies drawing rather than work again. Exact navigate_draw consumer chooses drawingTool. Sampled decoding explanation remains a recorded precision issue: describes smaller result, not source sampling. No unsupported full repair proposed. Current memory axahci wording is supported; no blanket insufficiency replacements. Existing header falsely claims empty/unstarted despite384 values, and should be corrected factually without claiming native review.

Files: nhe335-scope-review.json per-value statuses/refs/source pointers; nhe-full-author-proposals.json current16; nhe-reuse-alias-candidates.json separately; nhe384-existing-independent-review.json full inherited read; nhe384-existing-proposed-fixes.json two repairs. Placeholders checked against canonical. Complete-clause grammar and use-context acceptance belong to the next independent review before integration.
parent_review: Final 16 NHE full values separately read; rejected/withdrawn bare placed statuses and five document-page candidates. Spatial strike description refined, CENCAH same sense verified from the actual Chicontepec dictionary rather than assuming Classical meaning. All full legal/codec/guide prose remains unapproved.
